game.title: Company of Heroes 2
game.blurb: World War II real-time strategy game on the Eastern Front, from Relic Entertainment (RAWG also lists Feral Interactive), published by SEGA, released 2013-06-25. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genre: Strategy. Chapters follow the campaign, the Theater of War sets, the play modes and the intelligence bulletins named in the Steam achievements.

chapters.title: Campaign: Stalingrad Rail Station to Land Bridge to Leningrad
chapters.summary: Campaign Missions 01 to 07 on Conscript, Captain and General, with each mission's bonus objectives.

chapters.title: Campaign: Tiger Hunting to The Reichstag
chapters.summary: Campaign Missions 08 to 14 on each difficulty with their bonus objectives, plus finishing the whole campaign and campaign play counts. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Theater of War: 1941
chapters.summary: The 1941 challenges, co-op scenarios and battles, such as Blitzkrieg, Cold Weather, Brody Tank War, Moscow Lines and Battle of Minsk, with their bonus objectives.

chapters.title: Theater of War: Case Blue and Victory at Stalingrad
chapters.summary: Battles, challenges and scenarios such as Retreat at the Don, Tiger Ace, Assault on Voronezh, Stalingrad Encirclement, Tatsinskaya Raid and Kalach Pincer.

chapters.title: Theater of War: Southern Fronts
chapters.summary: Battles and challenges such as Breaking Lines, General Mud, Kharkov Divide, Heavy Rain, Occupation and Spring Rasputitsa.

chapters.title: Ranks, Skirmish and Automatch
chapters.summary: Ranks from Senior Private to Major General, games against the AI, automatch, Victory Point and Annihilate games, faction medallions, resource spending and play counts.

chapters.title: Intelligence Bulletins: Tanks and Vehicles
chapters.summary: Kill, build and veterancy goals for tanks, assault guns, rocket artillery, halftracks and scout cars, Soviet and German.

chapters.title: Intelligence Bulletins: Infantry and Support Weapons
chapters.summary: Goals for infantry squads, snipers, machine guns, mortars, anti-tank guns, howitzers, bunkers and mines, and finishing each bulletin set.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 10243). RAWG keeps "Company of Heroes 2 - Ardennes Assault" and "Company of Heroes 2: Southern Fronts" as separate entries, and the Steam store list has separate apps for "The Western Front Armies" (260309), "Ardennes Assault" (317850) and "The British Forces" (365820); they were not fetched, and no achievement in app 231430 names them. App 231430's schema is named "ValveTestApp55300" (a placeholder name); the store list confirms it as "Company of Heroes 2". StrategyWiki has no page under "Company of Heroes 2" or "Company of Heroes II". companyofheroes.fandom.com answers the API under "Company of Heroes 2" with about 13 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. There are 452 Steam achievements, and 3 are hidden: ev_mystery_01 to 03 ("Snore, Snore, Total Bore!", "Romeo is Dead!", "Romani Ite Domum", 0.8% to 1.5%). In a strategy game they are unlikely to be story beats, so they sit in the skirmish chapter as a placeholder. Campaign mission names and numbers come from the achievement descriptions; the split at mission 7 is our own choice. The descriptions name three Theater of War sets: 1941, Case Blue and Victory at Stalingrad (API names tow_dlc1 and tow_dlc2) and Southern Fronts (tow_dlc3). Which missions belong to Case Blue, Victory at Stalingrad and Southern Fronts is not stated: they were grouped by their position in the Steam list, just before each set's "Complete all" achievements, a reasoned guess; Case Blue and Victory at Stalingrad share one chapter. 1941 missions are named as 1941 only by the "Complete all ... in 1941" achievements and their place in the list. 125 achievements have API names starting "ib_", and nine of them read "Complete all ... intelligence bulletins", so the ib_ group is treated as the intelligence bulletins and split by unit type (tanks and vehicles versus infantry and support weapons); the split is our own and production goals that mix types were put by their first unit. The factions named are Soviet and German. The Theater of War play-count achievements (Play 1 to 100 challenges, scenarios or battles) sit in the skirmish chapter with the other play counts.
